# Google Slides

Google Slides is a cloud-based presentation editor with real-time collaboration, template gallery, and integration with other Google Workspace apps

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/googleslides/.

## Actions

- **Create Google Slides Presentation**: Create a blank or duplicate presentation.
- **Get Presentation** (read-only): Retrieve the latest version of a presentation.
- **Get Presentation Page** (read-only): Get the latest version of a specific page in a presentation.
- **Update Presentation (Batch/Markdown)**: Update existing google slides presentations with either raw api requests or markdown content.
- **Create Slides from Markdown**: Creates a new google slides presentation from markdown text.
- **Get Page Thumbnail** (read-only): Generate and return a thumbnail image url for a specific page.
